title: Grateful Dead Live at McArthur Court, U of Oregon on 1978-01-22
source: Analog Audience Source: FOB Master Cassettes (MAC) Medium Stock Brands: MAC = 3 x Maxell UDXL II Analog Lineage: 2 x  AKG D224E's => Sony TC 158SD >> MAC Analog Sound Preservation: MAC >> Nakamichi CR7a => Korg MR-1000 >> DSF [1-bit 5 -6448 MHz Stereo] >>  Korg AudioGate >> WAV [24/96]; Taped By: Reinhart Hohlwein Transfer By: Bob Menke Mastering By: Adam Egert

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience (FOB) tape of a fire‑filled 1978 Eugene show, highlighted by a smoking Close Encounter → St Stephen segue, classic post‑72 The Other One and a blazing Terrapin Station > Uncle John’s sequence.
ai_review.review: The recording captures the energy of an iconic 1978 Dead show with vivid audience ambience and virtually no technical flaws – reviewers rave about its crystal‑clear, dynamic sound. Musically the band is described as “on fire,” delivering standout moments such as the Close Encounter into St Stephen, a monster The Other One, and a scorching Terrapin Station → Uncle John’s transition, making this tape one of the era’s all‑time greats.

ai_rating.rationale: Nearly unanimous five‑star praise for both performance and sound quality; only a single modest comment about an average set, so overall rating is very high.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, dynamic FOB capture with minimal hiss; reviewers note it sounds like you’re there and praise the vivid live ambience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy throughout with seamless transitions, especially the Close Encounter into St Stephen and the Terrapin Station > Uncle John’s sequence that build to an epic second‑half climax.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers highlight Garcia’s nonstop fireworks – “cranking out one amazing solo after another” and a legendary Close Encounter theme woven into St Stephen.
